facts.F1: Bug 6706 — Jira: an in-progress item gets no start date when the search returns only part of its history. Found while fixing Bug #6705 (Jira Data Center). An item moved Open → waiting for approval → In analysis → In Progress on 16 May 2025, then In Progress → Suspended (a Doing state) on 13 Nov 2025, with many other edits in between. Lighthouse stored it as Doing with no start date. Effect: an old item still in progress gets no start date (since #6705 the server falls back to its created date, which overstates its age). A finished item gets its start from the closed-date fallback, so its cycle time can be wrong too. Fix direction: when the search answer holds only part of an item's history, fetch the item's full changelog before working out its start and closed dates.
